title: Shin Kidō Senki Gundam Wing: Endless Duel - Port (Re-Arranged)
description:
This is the Port stage theme from Gundam Wing: Endless Duel, which is a Gundam fighting game by Natsume made in the 90s for the SNES in Japan only. Also known as Deathscythe's stage theme.

This could definitely fit tense atlethic levels, but not much else sadly. At least, not in any scenario I can think of... lmao

Update: Once again, musicalman helped me with the tunings on this one; hopefully it should be better now
